title: Africa–Asia manganese ore exports
note: Manganese ores and concentrates, including ferruginous manganese ores and concentrates with a manganese content of 20% or more, calculated on the dry weight (HS 2602). This is the heading aggregate. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. Customs weight is not contained manganese metal and is not mine production. Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. This is not ferromanganese (HS 7202) and not manganese oxides (HS 2820). The Pink Sheet extract has no manganese series, so no manganese price is stored. A missing price is not zero.
